title: AgInS2/grapheme/TiO2 nano-composite membrane photoanode for photoinduced cathode protection as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of nano-composite membrane photoanode, and particularly relates to AgInS2/grapheme/TiO2 nano-composite membrane photoanode for photoinduced cathode protection as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method is characterized by comprising the following steps of immersing titanium matrix of the forming TiO2 nanotube array membrane inthe graphene oxide solution, carrying out hydrothermal reaction at 150-180 DEG C for 2-10 hours under a sealing condition, then cooling and washing, and drying to obtain the grapheme/TiO2 nano-composite membrane; immersing the obtained graphene the TiO2 nano composite membrane in an aqueous solution containing Ag<+>, In<3+> and S2<->, then sealing, high pressure, and calcining at the temperatureof 90-110 DEG C for 2-10 hours, after calcining, cooling to room temperature, washing and drying to obtain AgInS2/grapheme/Tio2 nano-composite membrane. The preparation method is simple in preparationprocess, the synthetic equipment is simple in requirement, safe and environment-friendly; and the AgInS2/grapheme/Tio2 nano-composite membrane has a potential application prospect in the aspect of photogenerated cathode protection.
